deleteAccount.seoDescription: How to request deletion of your Studafy account and data.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Studafy account at any time, with or without the app. You have 14 days to change your mind. After that, your account is removed from your school and your personal data is erased within 30 days. See the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for the records your school must keep.
deleteAccount.signedInBody: Go to <deleteLink>Account settings › Delete account</deleteLink> in the Studafy web app (or the equivalent screen in the mobile app) and confirm. No one else needs to act on it. You are signed out straight away, and you can cancel the deletion within 14 days by signing in again.
deleteAccount.signedOutBody: Enter the email address your school uses for your account. If it has a Studafy account, we will email it a link to confirm the deletion. The link works once, for one hour.
deleteAccount.noMailbox: No longer have access to that mailbox? Contact your school.
deleteAccount.noMailboxWithEmail: No longer have access to that mailbox? Contact your school, or email us at <mailLink>{{email}}</mailLink>.
deleteAccount.whatHappensBody: Straight away, you are signed out on every device. For 14 days, you can cancel the deletion by signing in again. After 14 days, your account is removed from your school and your links to any children are removed; a child's own account is not deleted. Your name, contact details and profile are then erased within 30 days, and we email you when your account is deleted. Deleting your account does not reliably cancel an AI subscription bought through Google Play or the App Store, so cancel it in the store first.
deleteAccount.retainedBody: Some records are kept because the law requires it: your grades and attendance (without your name or contact details), financial and payment records, and the audit log, including the record of this deletion. The text and photos of messages you sent are erased, except messages included in a report to your school, which it keeps as a safeguarding record. Your AI study history is deleted. Work you handed in stays in your school's records. See the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for detail.
deleteAccount.sent: If {{email}} has a Studafy account, we have sent it a link to confirm the deletion. Check your inbox and spam folder; the link expires in one hour.
deleteAccount.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
deleteAccount.captchaExpired: The challenge expired. Please complete it again.

confirmDeletion.seoDescription: Confirm deletion of your Studafy account.
confirmDeletion.title: Delete your account
confirmDeletion.body: This deletes the Studafy account registered to your email address, in every school it belongs to. Straight away, you are signed out on every device. 14 days later the account is removed from the school, unless you sign in and cancel the deletion first. Your name, contact details and profile are then erased within 30 days. Deleting your account does not reliably cancel an AI subscription bought through Google Play or the App Store, so cancel it in the store.
confirmDeletion.irreversible: After 14 days, this cannot be undone.
confirmDeletion.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used.
confirmDeletion.nothingBody: There is no active Studafy account for this email address any more. It may already have been deleted.
confirmDeletion.erasedBy: {{school}}: deleted on {{scheduledDate}} unless you sign in and cancel; personal data erased by {{date}}.
confirmDeletion.retainedIntro: We will email you when your account is deleted. These records are kept because the law requires it:
confirmDeletion.seePrivacy: The text and photos of messages you sent are erased, except messages included in a report to your school, and your AI study history is deleted. Work you handed in stays in your school's records. See the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for why.
